questions.qtext: Which of the following statements are correct?

options.text: Stress concentration in a machine component of ductile materials is harmful for static loading.
Stress concentration in a machine component of brittle materials is harmful for fluctuating loading.
Theoretical stress concentration factor can be ignored for ductile components subjected to static load.
Stress concentration in a machine component of ductile material is harmful for dynamic loading.

questions.solution:
(b, c, d)
• Ductile material undergoes local yielding and distribute the concentrated stress when subjected to stress concentration.
• However, when the load is fluctuating, the stress at discontinuities may exceed the endurance limit, and fail by fatigue.
• The effect of stress concentration is more severe in case of brittle material, due to the their
inability of plastic deformation.
